env GIT_EDITOR=true

# main and side diverge by rewriting f: every pick conflicts.
exec git init
exec git checkout -b main
exec git config user.email tester@email.com
exec git config user.name Testeur

cp f-base f
exec git add f
exec git commit -m base

exec git checkout -b side
cp f-a f
exec git commit -am ca
cp f-b f
exec git commit -am cb
cp f-c f
exec git commit -am cc

exec git checkout main
cp f-x f
exec git commit -am mainx

# Build gitmux and go back to work dir.
cd $GITMUX_DIR
go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

# Multi-commit cherry-pick pauses on step 1/3 with a conflict.
! exec git cherry-pick side~2 side~1 side
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[cherry-pick\] main 1/3 conflict 1\|C1'

# Resolve and continue: step advances to 2/3.
cp resolved f
exec git add f
! exec git cherry-pick --continue
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[cherry-pick\] main 2/3 conflict 1\|C1'

# Abort: sequencer metadata is cleared and main is back where it started.
exec git cherry-pick --abort
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
! stdout '\[cherry-pick\]'
stdout 'main'

# Single-commit pick that becomes empty: zero conflicts, but the operation is
# NOT complete and progress is unknown.
exec git checkout -b empty-side main
cp f-dup f
exec git commit -am side-dup
exec git checkout main
cp f-dup f
exec git commit -am main-dup
! exec git cherry-pick empty-side
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[cherry-pick\] main unknown empty'
! stdout 'conflict'
exec git cherry-pick --abort
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
! stdout '\[cherry-pick\]'

-- .gitignore --
.gitignore
.gopath
.tmp
gitmux
gitmux.yml
f-base
f-a
f-b
f-c
f-x
f-dup
resolved

-- f-base --
base
-- f-a --
aaa
-- f-b --
bbb
-- f-c --
ccc
-- f-x --
main-x
-- f-dup --
duplicated
-- resolved --
resolved-content
-- gitmux.yml --
tmux:
    symbols:
        branch: ""
        conflict: "C"
    styles:
        clear: ""
        state: ""
        branch: ""
        divergence: ""
        conflict: ""
        staged: ""
        op: ""
    layout: [branch, "|", op, "|", flags]
